title: Do you have one of these 20 British surnames? 5,500+ estates await rightful heirs in England and Wales
summary_full: More than 5,500 estates remain unclaimed across England and Wales after people died without valid wills or identifiable heirs. The UK government's latest list features 20 frequently appearing British surnames that may help relatives trace a possible inheritance. However, having one of these surnames does not automatically make someone eligible to claim an estate.
